note: One take of 12 benchmark cues plus 2 v2 A/B takes, plus 13 combat and death beats from R412 (broadside thump, 3-beat gauss, Glasswright shatter, Chorus acid sizzle and tendril lash) and R409 (the new 1586/1587 beats). No stems (Gate 3 only, on picked songs). Menu clicks come from free Sonniss/CC0 switches, not here. Every beat is atomic: no boom, tail or second stage inside a cue; the game layers them (godot/audio/death_audio.gd, sfx.gd).

items.prompt: Instrumental space fleet battle music for a tactical strategy game, restrained and clear, brass and tactical percussion over a low string ostinato, steady 90 BPM, steady energy throughout so it can loop, no lead melody that tires the ear, no vocals.
Short instrumental reward-screen music for a space strategy game, warm brass and strings, quietly triumphant, calm, not cheesy, no vocals.
Huge bulkhead locking clamps slamming shut one after another, deep metallic booms and a low hull groan, ominous. No beeps or synth tones.
Heavy brass lock tumblers turning and a vault latch releasing with a satisfying low clunk, then a faint ring of metal. No beeps or synth tones.
